'''2011 Minnesota State Championship Michael Pistone LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2011 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Bismack Biyombo
* '''Username:''' Pistone84
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
